description: Towne Centre at Somers is a well-established neighborhood shopping center strategically located at the intersection of Route 100 and Route 202 in Somers, New York. This 83,542 square foot community center serves one of Westchester County's most affluent markets, anchored by CVS Pharmacy and featuring a carefully curated mix of national and local tenants. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, the property benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility at a major traffic intersection, drawing approximately 1.4 million visits annually from the surrounding community. The center caters to the daily shopping needs of nearby residents with average household incomes exceeding $208,000, offering convenient access to pharmacy services, retail, dining, and professional services. With its strong tenant mix and prime location in a high-income trade area, Towne Centre at Somers has established itself as a vital community hub for Somers and the surrounding northern Westchester region.
